{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is NaN
df = df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue in descending order
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

# Get the channel with the highest revenue
top_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['channel']
top_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['revenue']

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel, top_channel, top_revenue"}
